intents.question: How do I make my website readable to AI systems without rebuilding it?
intents.answer: Signals are injected at the edge, in front of the existing site. The CMS is not modified. Removing the worker returns the site to its previous state.

intents.question: How do I find out what AI systems currently understand about my business?
intents.answer: Run the free audit at 3webobs.com. Three reports per domain per month are free. The audit is not sold by the injector.

intents.question: Who keeps my AI signals correct after the first fix?
intents.answer: The maintain plan re-audits weekly, corrects the automatic tier, queues the approval tier, and monitors what cannot be corrected. Every change is dated with before and after evidence and a rollback path.

intents.question: How can AI agents discover and invoke my services?
intents.answer: An agent card declares skills, pricing and endpoints, with idempotency and rate limiting. Agent readiness is tracked on the ADI scale L0 to L5, separately from the audit score.

intents.question: What does it cost?
intents.answer: Prices are published as machine-readable data at /pricing.json and rendered from that single source.

intents.question: Does this make my company EU AI Act compliant?
intents.answer: No. It supports readiness through traceability, transparency artefacts and a transaction log. Compliance is a legal assessment made by a qualified professional.

intents.question: Do you guarantee that ChatGPT will cite my business?
intents.answer: No. The guarantee covers what is controllable: signals live, endpoints valid, crawler access granted, identity consistent, interactions measured. Selection by any AI system is never guaranteed.
